page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes: two Greek notes in the right margin, beside the lines "Angitur animi quis vestrum?" and "E contra Animo quis est læto & hilari?". Running head at top, page number at top right. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: “sed tranquillo animo si quid affirman- “dum fit, nudè & fimpliciter affirmate; “si quid negandum, nudè & fimpliciter “negate. At si vos porrò stimulet acri- “or ex utravis parte animi impetus,non “ferentis se intra pectoris angustias “concludi, sed aliquâ exire gestientis: “veftrae erit prudentiae, animi illum ar- “dorem in honorem Dei convertere.

“Angitur animi quis vestrum? non ex[illegible, ~6 letters] “impatientia prorumpat statim in ju-[illegible, ~3 letters] “ramenta & blasphemias, quod irâ æ- “stuantibus proclive est: sed oret po- “tius & precetur Deum, ut quoad illa “mala auferantur, dèt fici[?] patientiam.

“E contra Animo quis est læto & hilari?[illegible, ~5 letters] “ne sic quidem in juramenta, qui Bac- “chantium mos est. ora solvat: sed hym- “nos potius & Psalmos in laudem Dei “moduletur,qui tam lætos ipsi dies con- cessit. Si quis Apostoli verba simplici- us intelligi malit, utatur suo judicio. Ex- pofui tantum quod mihi videtur non improbabile: nemini legem dico. Sed ut redeam ad institutum cursum, si ta- men digressus sum: illud interim cer- tum est Jacobi verba jurandi illud caco- ethes, quod apud omnes & summæ & abjectissimæ fortis homines pasim jam-

page.notes: Two Greek marginal notes in the right margin are too faint to read; marked illegible. "dèt fici[?]" in the line "mala auferantur" is doubtful. Short vertical marks at the left and right edges are binding and show-through, not transcribed. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The "æ" of "æstuantibus" is split across the line break and only the second part is printed on this line.
